function siteUpdateDateLabel(value){
if(!value)return "";
const d=new Date(value);
if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return "";
return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"});
}
function siteUpdateBodyHtml(value){
return esc(String(value||"")).replace(/\n/g,"<br>");
}

function monthlyBonusForPokemon(p){
  if(!p)return null;
  const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
  if(!slug)return null;
  return monthlyBonusPokemon.find(b=>String(b.catalog_slug||"")===slug)||null;
}
function monthlyBonusDateLabel(value){
  if(!value)return "";
  const d=new Date(`${value}T12:00:00`);
  if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"short",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"});
}
function monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row){
  return all().find(p=>String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"")===String(row?.catalog_slug||""))||null;
}
async function initializeMonthlyBonusEligibility(){
  if(!user||publicMode||isAdminTestMode()||!monthlyBonusPokemon.length)return;
  const caughtKeys=[];
  monthlyBonusPokemon.forEach(row=>{
    const p=monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row);
    if(p&&challengeData?.[p.id]?.caught)caughtKeys.push(String(p.id));
  });
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("initialize_monthly_bonus_user",{p_caught_keys:caughtKeys});
    if(error)console.warn("Monthly bonus eligibility initialization failed",error);
  }catch(err){console.warn("Monthly bonus eligibility initialization failed",err)}
}
async function loadMonthlyBonusPokemon(){
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_active_monthly_bonus_pokemon");
    if(error)throw error;
    monthlyBonusPokemon=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
    const first=monthlyBonusPokemon[0]||null;
    monthlyBonusPeriod=first?{id:first.period_id,name:first.period_name,start_date:first.start_date,end_date:first.end_date}:null;
    await initializeMonthlyBonusEligibility();
  }catch(err){
    console.warn("Could not load monthly bonus Pokémon",err);
    monthlyBonusPokemon=[];
    monthlyBonusPeriod=null;
  }
  renderHomeMonthlyBonus();
  if(document.getElementById("dexPage")?.classList.contains("active"))renderDex();
}
function renderHomeMonthlyBonus(){
  const box=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonus");
  const grid=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusGrid");
  if(!box||!grid)return;
  box.classList.remove("hidden");
  if(!monthlyBonusPokemon.length||!monthlyBonusPeriod){
    const title=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusTitle");
    const dates=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusDates");
    if(title)title.textContent="Pokémon of the Month";
    if(dates)dates.textContent="Monthly bonus Pokémon will appear here.";
    grid.innerHTML='<div style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:14px;text-align:center;color:#786f7c;font-size:13px">No Monthly Bonus Pokémon are active yet.</div>';
    return;
  }
  const title=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusTitle");
  const dates=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusDates");
  if(title)title.textContent=monthlyBonusPeriod.name||"Pokémon of the Month";
  if(dates)dates.textContent=`${monthlyBonusDateLabel(monthlyBonusPeriod.start_date)} – ${monthlyBonusDateLabel(monthlyBonusPeriod.end_date)}`;
  grid.innerHTML=monthlyBonusPokemon.map(row=>{
    const p=monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row);
    const caughtNow=!!(p&&challengeData?.[p.id]?.caught);
    const src=String(p?.image||row.image_url||(+row.dex_number?image(+row.dex_number):"")).trim();
    const name=row.pokemon_name||p?.name||"Pokémon";
    const form=row.form_name||p?.form||"";
    return `<div class="home-monthly-mon" role="${p?"button":"img"}" tabindex="${p?"0":"-1"}" ${p?`onclick="openPokemon('${esc(p.id)}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();openPokemon('${esc(p.id)}')}"`:""}>
      ${caughtNow?'<span class="home-monthly-mon-caught">✓ CAUGHT</span>':""}
      <span class="home-monthly-mon-x">${Number(row.multiplier||2)}×</span>
      <div class="home-monthly-mon-img">${src?`<img src="${esc(src)}" alt="${esc(name)}">`:'<div class="placeholder-mon">?</div>'}</div>
      <div class="home-monthly-mon-name">${esc(name)}</div>
      ${form?`<div class="home-monthly-mon-form">${esc(form)}</div>`:""}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
async function syncMonthlyBonusForPokemon(p,isCaught){
  if(publicMode||!user||isAdminTestMode()||!p)return 0;
  const slug=catalogSlugForPokemon(p);
  if(!slug)return 0;
  try{
    if(isCaught){
      const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("award_monthly_bonus",{p_pokemon_key:String(p.id),p_catalog_slug:String(slug)});
      if(error){console.error(error);return 0}
      return Math.max(0,Number(data)||0);
    }
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("remove_monthly_bonus",{p_pokemon_key:String(p.id)});
    if(error)console.error(error);
    return 0;
  }catch(err){console.error(err);return 0}
}
function adminMonthlyCatalogRows(){
  const seen=new Set();
  return all().filter(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    if(!slug||seen.has(slug)||p.custom)return false;
    seen.add(slug);return true;
  }).sort((a,b)=>(+a.dex||99999)-(+b.dex||99999)||String(a.name||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||""))||String(a.form||"").localeCompare(String(b.form||"")));
}
function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

===== TERM 'Monthly Bonus' AT 26347796 =====
function monthlyBonusForPokemon(p){
  if(!p)return null;
  const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
  if(!slug)return null;
  return monthlyBonusPokemon.find(b=>String(b.catalog_slug||"")===slug)||null;
}
function monthlyBonusDateLabel(value){
  if(!value)return "";
  const d=new Date(`${value}T12:00:00`);
  if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))return String(value);
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"short",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"});
}
function monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row){
  return all().find(p=>String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"")===String(row?.catalog_slug||""))||null;
}
async function initializeMonthlyBonusEligibility(){
  if(!user||publicMode||isAdminTestMode()||!monthlyBonusPokemon.length)return;
  const caughtKeys=[];
  monthlyBonusPokemon.forEach(row=>{
    const p=monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row);
    if(p&&challengeData?.[p.id]?.caught)caughtKeys.push(String(p.id));
  });
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("initialize_monthly_bonus_user",{p_caught_keys:caughtKeys});
    if(error)console.warn("Monthly bonus eligibility initialization failed",error);
  }catch(err){console.warn("Monthly bonus eligibility initialization failed",err)}
}
async function loadMonthlyBonusPokemon(){
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_active_monthly_bonus_pokemon");
    if(error)throw error;
    monthlyBonusPokemon=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
    const first=monthlyBonusPokemon[0]||null;
    monthlyBonusPeriod=first?{id:first.period_id,name:first.period_name,start_date:first.start_date,end_date:first.end_date}:null;
    await initializeMonthlyBonusEligibility();
  }catch(err){
    console.warn("Could not load monthly bonus Pokémon",err);
    monthlyBonusPokemon=[];
    monthlyBonusPeriod=null;
  }
  renderHomeMonthlyBonus();
  if(document.getElementById("dexPage")?.classList.contains("active"))renderDex();
}
function renderHomeMonthlyBonus(){
  const box=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonus");
  const grid=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusGrid");
  if(!box||!grid)return;
  box.classList.remove("hidden");
  if(!monthlyBonusPokemon.length||!monthlyBonusPeriod){
    const title=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusTitle");
    const dates=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusDates");
    if(title)title.textContent="Pokémon of the Month";
    if(dates)dates.textContent="Monthly bonus Pokémon will appear here.";
    grid.innerHTML='<div style="grid-column:1/-1;padding:14px;text-align:center;color:#786f7c;font-size:13px">No Monthly Bonus Pokémon are active yet.</div>';
    return;
  }
  const title=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusTitle");
  const dates=document.getElementById("homeMonthlyBonusDates");
  if(title)title.textContent=monthlyBonusPeriod.name||"Pokémon of the Month";
  if(dates)dates.textContent=`${monthlyBonusDateLabel(monthlyBonusPeriod.start_date)} – ${monthlyBonusDateLabel(monthlyBonusPeriod.end_date)}`;
  grid.innerHTML=monthlyBonusPokemon.map(row=>{
    const p=monthlyBonusPokemonFromRow(row);
    const caughtNow=!!(p&&challengeData?.[p.id]?.caught);
    const src=String(p?.image||row.image_url||(+row.dex_number?image(+row.dex_number):"")).trim();
    const name=row.pokemon_name||p?.name||"Pokémon";
    const form=row.form_name||p?.form||"";
    return `<div class="home-monthly-mon" role="${p?"button":"img"}" tabindex="${p?"0":"-1"}" ${p?`onclick="openPokemon('${esc(p.id)}')" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();openPokemon('${esc(p.id)}')}"`:""}>
      ${caughtNow?'<span class="home-monthly-mon-caught">✓ CAUGHT</span>':""}
      <span class="home-monthly-mon-x">${Number(row.multiplier||2)}×</span>
      <div class="home-monthly-mon-img">${src?`<img src="${esc(src)}" alt="${esc(name)}">`:'<div class="placeholder-mon">?</div>'}</div>
      <div class="home-monthly-mon-name">${esc(name)}</div>
      ${form?`<div class="home-monthly-mon-form">${esc(form)}</div>`:""}
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
async function syncMonthlyBonusForPokemon(p,isCaught){
  if(publicMode||!user||isAdminTestMode()||!p)return 0;
  const slug=catalogSlugForPokemon(p);
  if(!slug)return 0;
  try{
    if(isCaught){
      const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("award_monthly_bonus",{p_pokemon_key:String(p.id),p_catalog_slug:String(slug)});
      if(error){console.error(error);return 0}
      return Math.max(0,Number(data)||0);
    }
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("remove_monthly_bonus",{p_pokemon_key:String(p.id)});
    if(error)console.error(error);
    return 0;
  }catch(err){console.error(err);return 0}
}
function adminMonthlyCatalogRows(){
  const seen=new Set();
  return all().filter(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    if(!slug||seen.has(slug)||p.custom)return false;
    seen.add(slug);return true;
  }).sort((a,b)=>(+a.dex||99999)-(+b.dex||99999)||String(a.name||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||""))||String(a.form||"").localeCompare(String(b.form||"")));
}
function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

function renderSiteUpdates(){

const addBtn=document.getElementById("addSiteUpdateBtn");
if(addBtn)addBtn.classList.toggle("hidden",!isAdmin);

}else{

list.classList.toggle("show-all",showAllSiteUpdates&&siteUpdates.length>2);
list.innerHTML=visibleUpdates.map((u,i)=>`<details class="site-update-card ${i===0?"latest":""}" ${i===0?"open":""}><summary class="site-update-summary"><div class="site-update-summary-main"><div class="site-update-meta"><span class="site-update-date">${esc(siteUpdateDateLabel(u.published_at))}</span>${i===0?'<span class="site-update-new">NEW</span>':""}</div><div class="site-update-title">${esc(u.title||"Update")}</div></div><span class="site-update-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary><div class="site-update-collapsible-body"><div class="site-update-body">${siteUpdateBodyHtml(u.body)}</div>${isAdmin?`<div class="site-update-admin-actions"><button class="secondary" type="button" onclick="editSiteUpdate('${esc(u.id)}')">Edit</button><button class="danger" type="button" onclick="deleteSiteUpdate('${esc(u.id)}')">Delete</button></div>`:""}</div></details>`).join("");
}
const viewMore=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesViewMoreBtn");
if(viewMore){
 viewMore.classList.toggle("hidden",siteUpdates.length<=2);
 viewMore.textContent=showAllSiteUpdates?"Show Less":"View More Updates";
}
}
const teaser=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdate");
if(teaser){
const u=siteUpdates[0];
teaser.classList.toggle("hidden",!u);
if(u){
const title=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateTitle"),date=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateDate"),body=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateBody");
if(title)title.textContent=u.title||"Site Update";
if(date)date.textContent=siteUpdateDateLabel(u.published_at);
if(body){
const clean=String(u.body||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
body.textContent=clean.length>190?clean.slice(0,187)+"…":clean;
}
}
}
}

function randomizeAdminMonthlyBonus(){
  const pool=adminMonthlyCatalogRows().slice();
  for(let i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[pool[i],pool[j]]=[pool[j],pool[i]]}

async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}
async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

}
const viewMore=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesViewMoreBtn");
if(viewMore){
 viewMore.classList.toggle("hidden",siteUpdates.length<=2);
 viewMore.textContent=showAllSiteUpdates?"Show Less":"View More Updates";
}

if(teaser){
const u=siteUpdates[0];
teaser.classList.toggle("hidden",!u);
if(u){
const title=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateTitle"),date=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateDate"),body=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateBody");

body.textContent=clean.length>190?clean.slice(0,187)+"…":clean;
}

function randomizeAdminMonthlyBonus(){
  const pool=adminMonthlyCatalogRows().slice();
  for(let i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[pool[i],pool[j]]=[pool[j],pool[i]]}
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(pool.slice(0,10).map(p=>({catalog_slug:catalogSlugForPokemon(p),multiplier:2})));
}
async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}
async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}

async function toggleCaught(){
 const pokemonId=currentPokemonId,e=entry(pokemonId),p=all().find(x=>x.id===pokemonId);
 if(!e.caught&&!e.books.length){toast("Add a book title first, then you can mark this Pokémon as caught.");return}
 if(!e.caught){
   const missingChar=missingUnownSpecialTitleCharacter(p,e);
   if(missingChar){toast(`To catch ${p?.form||p?.rawForm||p?.name||"this Unown"}, the book title must contain ${missingChar}.`);return}
   const conflict=duplicateCaughtBookConflict(p,e);
   if(conflict){toast(`That reading is already being used for ${conflict.name||"another Pokémon"}. Re-read it to use it again. Unown are the exception and may reuse a reading already used elsewhere.`);return}
 }
 const wasCaught=!!e.caught;
 e.caught=!e.caught;
 if(!wasCaught&&e.caught&&e.safariMarked)e.safariCatch=true;
 if(!wasCaught&&e.caught&&e.shinySaved&&isShinyEligiblePokemon(p)){
   e.shinyCaught=true;
   e.shinyView="shiny";
 }
 await saveNow();
 invalidateAchievementEvolutionExpert();
 syncAchievementMilestoneNotification();
 if(!wasCaught)await logTeamCatchForPokemon(p,e);
 const earnedBonus=await syncMyTeamBonusForPokemon(p,!wasCaught);
 const monthlyBonusExtra=await syncMonthlyBonusForPokemon(p,!wasCaught);
 openPokemon(pokemonId);
 if(wasCaught){
   toastWithUndo("Marked uncaught.",async()=>{
     entry(pokemonId).caught=true;
     await saveNow();
     invalidateAchievementEvolutionExpert();
     syncAchievementMilestoneNotification();
     await syncMyTeamBonusForPokemon(p,true);
     await syncMonthlyBonusForPokemon(p,true);
     openPokemon(pokemonId);
     toast("Restored as caught.");
   });
 }else{
   const dolls=joinedFaction()?.slug==="poke-dolls";
   if(e.shinyCaught&&e.shinySaved)toast("✨ Shiny caught! Its shiny artwork is now permanently unlocked.");
   else{
     const totalPoints=1+(earnedBonus?1:0)+monthlyBonusExtra;
     if(earnedBonus&&monthlyBonusExtra)toast(dolls?`Caught! 💗 Team + Monthly bonuses: ${totalPoints} hearts!`:`Caught! ⭐ Team + Monthly bonuses: ${totalPoints} points!`);
     else if(monthlyBonusExtra)toast(dolls?`Caught! 💗 Monthly Bonus: ${totalPoints} hearts!`:`Caught! ⭐ Monthly Bonus: ${totalPoints} points!`);
     else toast(earnedBonus?(dolls?"Caught! 💗 Team Pokémon bonus: +2 hearts!":"Caught! ⭐ Team Pokémon bonus: 2 points!"):"Caught!");
   }
 }
}

function hauntedSafariDescriptor(p){return `${p?.name||""} ${p?.form||""} ${p?.rawForm||""} ${p?.slug||""} ${p?.formApiName||""}`.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g," ").trim()}
function hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,tokens=[]){const d=hauntedSafariDescriptor(p);return !tokens.some(t=>d.includes(t))}
function isHauntedSafariPokemon(p){
  if(!p||p.custom)return false;
  const n=String(p.name||"");
  const d=hauntedSafariDescriptor(p);
  if(HAUNTED_SAFARI_ALL_FORM_NAMES.has(n))return true;
  if(n==="Rattata"||n==="Raticate")return d.includes("alola");
  if(n==="Marowak")return d.includes("alola");
  if(n==="Moltres")return d.includes("galar");
  if(n==="Typhlosion")return d.includes("hisui");
  if(n==="Zigzagoon"||n==="Linoone")return d.includes("galar");
  if(n==="Giratina")return d.includes("altered")||d.includes("origin")||hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["origin"]);
  if(n==="Castform")return hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["sunny","rainy","snowy"]);
  if(n==="Yamask")return hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["galar"])||d.includes("galar");
  if(n==="Zorua"||n==="Zoroark")return hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["hisui"])||d.includes("hisui");
  if(n==="Oricorio")return d.includes("sensu");
  if(n==="Lycanroc")return d.includes("midnight");
  if(n==="Necrozma")return d.includes("dawn")||hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["dusk","ultra","dawn"]);
  if(n==="Marshadow")return d.includes("zenith")||hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,["zenith"]);
  if(n==="Toxtricity")return d.includes("low key")||d.includes("amped")||d.includes("lowkey")||d.includes("amped form");
  if(n==="Morpeko")return d.includes("hangry");
  if(n==="Calyrex")return d.includes("shadow");
  if(n==="Ursaluna")return d.includes("bloodmoon")||d.includes("blood moon");
  if(n==="Basculegion")return d.includes("male")||d.includes("female")||d.includes(" m ")||d.includes(" f ")||hauntedSafariBaseForm(p,[]);
  if(n==="Gimmighoul")return d.includes("chest")||d.includes("roaming");
  return false;
}
function hauntedSafariAvailable(){return isAdminTestMode()||specialEventIsLive("haunted-safari")}
function isHauntedSafariMode(){return safariMode==="haunted"&&hauntedSafariAvailable()}
function setSafariMode(mode){
  const next=mode==="haunted"&&hauntedSafariAvailable()?"haunted":"regular";
  if(next===safariMode)return syncSafariModeUi();
  if(!clearSafariEncounter())return;
  safariMode=next;
  syncSafariModeUi();
}
function syncSafariModeUi(){
  const hauntedAvailable=hauntedSafariAvailable();
  if(!hauntedAvailable&&safariMode!=="regular")safariMode="regular";
  const haunted=isHauntedSafariMode();
  const page=document.getElementById("safariPage");
  const toggle=document.getElementById("safariModeToggle");
  toggle?.classList.toggle("hidden",!hauntedAvailable);
  page?.classList.toggle("haunted-safari",haunted);
  document.getElementById("regularSafariModeBtn")?.classList.toggle("active",!haunted);
  document.getElementById("hauntedSafariModeBtn")?.classList.toggle("active",haunted);
  const regularBtn=document.getElementById("regularSafariModeBtn"),hauntedBtn=document.getElementById("hauntedSafariModeBtn");
  if(regularBtn)regularBtn.className=haunted?"secondary":"primary active";
  if(hauntedBtn)hauntedBtn.className=haunted?"primary active":"secondary";
  document.getElementById("regularSafariControls")?.classList.toggle("hidden",haunted);
  document.getElementById("regularGrassField")?.classList.toggle("hidden",haunted);
  document.getElementById("regularGrassHelp")?.classList.toggle("hidden",haunted);
  document.getElementById("hauntedSafariControls")?.classList.toggle("hidden",!haunted);
  document.getElementById("hauntedGraveyardField")?.classList.toggle("hidden",!haunted);
  document.getElementById("hauntedGraveyardHelp")?.classList.toggle("hidden",!haunted);
  const title=document.getElementById("safariTitle");
  if(title)title.textContent=haunted?"Haunted Safari":"Safari Zone";
  const intro=document.getElementById("safariIntroText");
  if(intro&&haunted)intro.innerHTML="Welcome to the Haunted Safari test! Search the graveyard to encounter only your Halloween event Pokémon pool. This patch is focused on the visual theme first, so the shiny rules are still using the current Safari test settings. Use the Show filter below to switch between caught, uncaught, or both.";
  else if(intro&&intro.dataset.regularSafariIntro)intro.innerHTML=intro.dataset.regularSafariIntro;
}

function formSpriteGuess(r){
const dex=+r?.dex_number||0,api=formApiNameFromRow(r),base=String(r?.name||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g,"");
let suffix=api.startsWith(base+"-")?api.slice(base.length+1):"";
if(!dex||!suffix)return dex?image(dex):"";
suffix=suffix.replace(/-forme$/," ").replace(/-form$/," ").replace(/-style$/," ").replace(/-mode$/," ").trim().replace(/\s+/g,"-");
return `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/${dex}-${suffix}.png`;
}
function formTokens(s){
const ignore=new Set(["form","forme","style","mode","pokemon"]);
const aliases={alolan:"alola",galarian:"galar",hisuian:"hisui",paldean:"paldea",stripe:"striped"};
return String(s||"").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-").split("-").filter(Boolean).map(x=>aliases[x]||x).filter(x=>!ignore.has(x));
}

}

if(found)return found;
}catch{}
}
return "";
}
async function resolveFormImage(apiName,dex=0,formLabel="",baseName=""){
apiName=String(apiName||"").trim().toLowerCase();
const cacheKey=[apiName,dex,formLabel,baseName].join("|").toLowerCase();
if(!apiName)return "";
if(formImageCache[cacheKey])return formImageCache[cacheKey];
if(formImagePending.has(cacheKey))return formImagePending.get(cacheKey);

add(apiName.replace(/-origin-forme$/,"-origin").replace(/-therian-forme$/,"-therian").replace(/-incarnate-forme$/,"-incarnate"));
add(apiName.replace(/-blue-stripe$/,"-blue-striped").replace(/-red-stripe$/,"-red-striped").replace(/-white-stripe$/,"-white-striped"));
const regional=apiName.match(/^(alolan|galarian|hisuian|paldean)-(.+)$/);
if(regional){const m={alolan:"alola",galarian:"galar",hisuian:"hisui",paldean:"paldea"};add(`${regional[2]}-${m[regional[1]]}`);add(`${regional[2].replace(/-(forme|form|style|mode)$/,'')}-${m[regional[1]]}`)}
for(const n of direct){const found=await fetchFormSprite(n);if(found){formImageCache[cacheKey]=found;try{localStorage.setItem(FORM_IMAGE_CACHE_KEY,JSON.stringify(formImageCache))}catch{}return found}}
const names=await pokeFormNames();
const baseTokens=new Set(formTokens(baseName));
const wanted=formTokens(`${apiName} ${formLabel}`).filter(t=>!baseTokens.has(t));
let best="",bestScore=0;
for(const n of names){
const nt=formTokens(n);
if(baseTokens.size&&![...baseTokens].every(t=>nt.includes(t)))continue;
let score=0;
for(const t of wanted)if(nt.includes(t))score+=3;
score-=Math.max(0,nt.length-(wanted.length+baseTokens.size));
if(score>bestScore){bestScore=score;best=n}
}
if(best&&bestScore>0){const found=await fetchFormSprite(best);if(found){formImageCache[cacheKey]=found;try{localStorage.setItem(FORM_IMAGE_CACHE_KEY,JSON.stringify(formImageCache))}catch{}return found}}
return "";
})().finally(()=>formImagePending.delete(cacheKey));

}

function displayFormLabel(name,formName){

if(!f)return "";
if(n)f=f.replace(new RegExp(n.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,"\\$&"),"i"),"").trim();

}
function formOnlyDexes(){
const grouped=new Map();
globalChallengeData.forEach(r=>{
const d=+r.dex_number;if(!d)return;
const x=grouped.get(d)||{standard:false,forms:false};
if(r.form_name)x.forms=true;else x.standard=true;
grouped.set(d,x);
});
const exceptions=new Set([29,32,669]);
return new Set([...grouped].filter(([d,x])=>x.forms&&!x.standard&&!exceptions.has(d)).map(([d])=>d));
}
function normalizeFormKey(v,name=""){
let x=String(v||"").toLowerCase().trim();
const n=String(name||"").toLowerCase().trim();
if(n)x=x.replaceAll(n,"");
return x.replace(/\b(forme|form|style|mode)\b/g,"").replace(/[()_%]/g," ").replace(/[-_/]+/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
}
function metadataForPokemon(p){
if(!p?.dex)return null;
const dex=+p.dex;
if(p.isForm&&p.form){
const exact=globalChallengeData.find(r=>+r.dex_number===dex&&String(r.form_name||"").toLowerCase()===String(p.form).toLowerCase());
if(exact)return exact;
const target=normalizeFormKey(p.rawForm||p.form,p.name);
const fuzzy=globalChallengeData.find(r=>+r.dex_number===dex&&r.form_name&&normalizeFormKey(r.form_name,r.name)===target);
if(fuzzy)return fuzzy;
}
const standard=globalChallengeData.find(r=>+r.dex_number===dex&&!r.form_name);
if(standard)return standard;
if(dex===29||dex===32||dex===669)return globalChallengeData.find(r=>+r.dex_number===dex)||null;
return null;
}
function catalogSlugForPokemon(p){
if(!p||p.custom)return "";
if(p.slug)return p.slug;
return metadataForPokemon(p)?.slug||"";
}

manualShinyImage:!!m.shiny_image_url,
types:[m.type_1,m.type_2].filter(Boolean),
prompt:m.reading_prompt||p.prompt||"",
fact:m.dex_fact||p.fact||""
};
}).filter(p=>!(hideBases.has(+p.dex)&&!p.isForm));
}

}
function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
function renderAdminMonthlyPeriodSelect(){

function loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(id=""){
  editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=id||null;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(id))||null;

  const name=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName");
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart");
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd");
  const enabled=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled");
  if(name)name.value=period?.name||defaults.name;
  if(start)start.value=period?.start_date||defaults.start;
  if(end)end.value=period?.end_date||defaults.end;
  if(enabled)enabled.checked=period?period.enabled!==false:true;

async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}
async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

async function loadSiteUpdates(){
if(publicMode||!user)return;
const{data,error}=await sb.from("site_updates").select("id,title,body,published_at,created_at,updated_at").order("published_at",{ascending:false}).order("created_at",{ascending:false});
if(error){
console.error("Could not load site updates",error);
siteUpdates=[];
}else siteUpdates=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
renderSiteUpdates();
}
function renderSiteUpdates(){
const list=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesList");
const addBtn=document.getElementById("addSiteUpdateBtn");
if(addBtn)addBtn.classList.toggle("hidden",!isAdmin);
if(list){
if(!siteUpdates.length){
list.innerHTML='<div class="site-update-empty">No updates have been posted yet.</div>';
}else{
const visibleUpdates=showAllSiteUpdates?siteUpdates:siteUpdates.slice(0,2);
list.classList.toggle("show-all",showAllSiteUpdates&&siteUpdates.length>2);
list.innerHTML=visibleUpdates.map((u,i)=>`<details class="site-update-card ${i===0?"latest":""}" ${i===0?"open":""}><summary class="site-update-summary"><div class="site-update-summary-main"><div class="site-update-meta"><span class="site-update-date">${esc(siteUpdateDateLabel(u.published_at))}</span>${i===0?'<span class="site-update-new">NEW</span>':""}</div><div class="site-update-title">${esc(u.title||"Update")}</div></div><span class="site-update-chevron" aria-hidden="true">⌄</span></summary><div class="site-update-collapsible-body"><div class="site-update-body">${siteUpdateBodyHtml(u.body)}</div>${isAdmin?`<div class="site-update-admin-actions"><button class="secondary" type="button" onclick="editSiteUpdate('${esc(u.id)}')">Edit</button><button class="danger" type="button" onclick="deleteSiteUpdate('${esc(u.id)}')">Delete</button></div>`:""}</div></details>`).join("");
}
const viewMore=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesViewMoreBtn");
if(viewMore){
 viewMore.classList.toggle("hidden",siteUpdates.length<=2);
 viewMore.textContent=showAllSiteUpdates?"Show Less":"View More Updates";
}
}
const teaser=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdate");
if(teaser){
const u=siteUpdates[0];
teaser.classList.toggle("hidden",!u);
if(u){
const title=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateTitle"),date=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateDate"),body=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateBody");
if(title)title.textContent=u.title||"Site Update";
if(date)date.textContent=siteUpdateDateLabel(u.published_at);
if(body){
const clean=String(u.body||"").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
body.textContent=clean.length>190?clean.slice(0,187)+"…":clean;
}
}
}
}
function toggleAllSiteUpdates(){
showAllSiteUpdates=!showAllSiteUpdates;
renderSiteUpdates();
const list=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesList");
if(showAllSiteUpdates){
 setTimeout(()=>list?.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"nearest"}),40);
}else{
 setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById("recentUpdatesSection")?.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",block:"start"}),40);
}
}

goPage("faq");
setTimeout(()=>{
document.getElementById("faqPage")?.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth",

function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}
function renderAdminMonthlyPeriodSelect(){
  const select=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPeriodSelect");if(!select)return;
  select.innerHTML='<option value="">New period</option>'+adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.id)}">${esc(p.name||"Monthly Bonus")} • ${esc(p.start_date||"")}</option>`).join("");
  select.value=editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||"";
}
function loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(id=""){
  editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=id||null;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(id))||null;
  const defaults=defaultMonthlyDates();
  const name=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName");
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart");
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd");
  const enabled=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled");
  if(name)name.value=period?.name||defaults.name;
  if(start)start.value=period?.start_date||defaults.start;
  if(end)end.value=period?.end_date||defaults.end;
  if(enabled)enabled.checked=period?period.enabled!==false:true;
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(period?.items||[]);
  document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusDeleteBtn")?.classList.toggle("hidden",!period);
  renderAdminMonthlyPeriodSelect();
}
function newAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor("")}
function clearAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(){renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots([])}
function randomizeAdminMonthlyBonus(){
  const pool=adminMonthlyCatalogRows().slice();
  for(let i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[pool[i],pool[j]]=[pool[j],pool[i]]}
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(pool.slice(0,10).map(p=>({catalog_slug:catalogSlugForPokemon(p),multiplier:2})));
}
async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}

function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

function renderAdminMonthlyPeriodSelect(){
  const select=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPeriodSelect");if(!select)return;
  select.innerHTML='<option value="">New period</option>'+adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.id)}">${esc(p.name||"Monthly Bonus")} • ${esc(p.start_date||"")}</option>`).join("");
  select.value=editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||"";
}
function loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(id=""){
  editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=id||null;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(id))||null;
  const defaults=defaultMonthlyDates();
  const name=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName");
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart");
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd");
  const enabled=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled");
  if(name)name.value=period?.name||defaults.name;
  if(start)start.value=period?.start_date||defaults.start;
  if(end)end.value=period?.end_date||defaults.end;
  if(enabled)enabled.checked=period?period.enabled!==false:true;
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(period?.items||[]);
  document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusDeleteBtn")?.classList.toggle("hidden",!period);
  renderAdminMonthlyPeriodSelect();
}
function newAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor("")}
function clearAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(){renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots([])}
function randomizeAdminMonthlyBonus(){
  const pool=adminMonthlyCatalogRows().slice();
  for(let i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[pool[i],pool[j]]=[pool[j],pool[i]]}
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(pool.slice(0,10).map(p=>({catalog_slug:catalogSlugForPokemon(p),multiplier:2})));
}
async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}
async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

console.error("Could not load site updates",error);
siteUpdates=[];

}
const viewMore=document.getElementById("siteUpdatesViewMoreBtn");
if(viewMore){
 viewMore.classList.toggle("hidden",siteUpdates.length<=2);
 viewMore.textContent=showAllSiteUpdates?"Show Less":"View More Updates";
}
}
const teaser=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdate");
if(teaser){
const u=siteUpdates[0];
teaser.classList.toggle("hidden",!u);
if(u){
const title=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateTitle"),date=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateDate"),body=document.getElementById("homeLatestUpdateBody");

  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();

async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){

    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}

  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){

}

function adminMonthlyCatalogRows(){
  const seen=new Set();
  return all().filter(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    if(!slug||seen.has(slug)||p.custom)return false;
    seen.add(slug);return true;
  }).sort((a,b)=>(+a.dex||99999)-(+b.dex||99999)||String(a.name||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||""))||String(a.form||"").localeCompare(String(b.form||"")));
}
function adminMonthlyOptionHtml(selected=""){
  return `<option value="">Choose Pokémon…</option>`+adminMonthlyCatalogRows().map(p=>{
    const slug=String(catalogSlugForPokemon(p)||"");
    const label=`${p.dex?`#${String(p.dex).padStart(4,"0")} • `:""}${p.name||"Pokémon"}${p.form?` • ${p.form}`:""}`;
    return `<option value="${esc(slug)}" ${slug===String(selected)?"selected":""}>${esc(label)}</option>`;
  }).join("");
}
function defaultMonthlyDates(){
  const d=new Date(),y=d.getFullYear(),m=d.getMonth();
  const start=new Date(y,m,1),end=new Date(y,m+1,0);
  const f=x=>`${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  return {start:f(start),end:f(end),name:d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:"long",year:"numeric"})};
}
function renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(items=[]){
  const box=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList");if(!box)return;
  const rows=Array.isArray(items)?items:[];
  box.innerHTML=Array.from({length:10},(_,i)=>{
    const item=rows[i]||{};
    const mult=Math.max(2,Math.min(5,Number(item.multiplier)||2));
    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd");

  if(name)name.value=period?.name||defaults.name;
  if(start)start.value=period?.start_date||defaults.start;
  if(end)end.value=period?.end_date||defaults.end;

async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

    return `<div class="admin-monthly-pokemon-row">
      <div class="admin-monthly-slot-num">${i+1}</div>
      <select class="admin-monthly-pokemon-select">${adminMonthlyOptionHtml(item.catalog_slug||"")}</select>
      <select class="admin-monthly-multiplier">${[2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<option value="${n}" ${mult===n?"selected":""}>${n}×</option>`).join("")}</select>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function randomizeAdminMonthlyBonus(){
  const pool=adminMonthlyCatalogRows().slice();
  for(let i=pool.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[pool[i],pool[j]]=[pool[j],pool[i]]}
  renderAdminMonthlyBonusSlots(pool.slice(0,10).map(p=>({catalog_slug:catalogSlugForPokemon(p),multiplier:2})));

async function loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("get_admin_monthly_bonus_periods");
    if(error)throw error;
    adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=Array.isArray(data)?data:[];
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);adminMonthlyBonusPeriods=[];toast("Could not load Monthly Bonus settings.");
  }
  const stillExists=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.some(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||""));
  loadAdminMonthlyBonusEditor(stillExists?editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId:"");
}
async function saveAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin)return;
  const name=String(document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusName")?.value||"").trim();
  const start=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusStart")?.value||"";
  const end=document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnd")?.value||"";
  const enabled=!!document.getElementById("adminMonthlyBonusEnabled")?.checked;
  const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("#adminMonthlyBonusPokemonList .admin-monthly-pokemon-row")];
  const items=rows.map((row,i)=>({
    catalog_slug:String(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-pokemon-select")?.value||""),
    multiplier:Number(row.querySelector(".admin-monthly-multiplier")?.value||2),
    sort_order:i
  })).filter(x=>x.catalog_slug);
  if(!name||!start||!end){toast("Add a name, start date, and end date.");return}
  if(!items.length){toast("Choose at least one Monthly Bonus Pokémon.");return}
  const dupes=items.map(x=>x.catalog_slug).filter((x,i,a)=>a.indexOf(x)!==i);
  if(dupes.length){toast("Each Monthly Bonus Pokémon can only be selected once.");return}
  try{
    const{data,error}=await sb.rpc("admin_save_monthly_bonus_period",{
      p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId||null,p_name:name,p_start_date:start,p_end_date:end,p_enabled:enabled,p_items:items
    });
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=data||editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId;
    toast("Monthly Bonus Pokémon saved.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not save Monthly Bonus Pokémon.")}
}
async function deleteAdminMonthlyBonusPeriod(){
  if(!isAdmin||!editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId)return;
  const period=adminMonthlyBonusPeriods.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId));
  if(!window.confirm(`Delete ${period?.name||"this Monthly Bonus period"}?`))return;
  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});
    if(error)throw error;
    editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId=null;
    toast("Monthly Bonus period deleted.");
    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();
  }catch(err){console.error(err);toast(err.message||"Could not delete Monthly Bonus period.")}
}

  try{
    const{error}=await sb.rpc("admin_delete_monthly_bonus_period",{p_period_id:editingMonthlyBonusPeriodId});

    await loadAdminMonthlyBonusPeriods();
    await loadMonthlyBonusPokemon();
    renderHome();

}

function rememberPage(n){
const parent=n==="detail"?"dex":n;
const allowed=publicMode?["home","dex","stats"]:["home","dex","safari","gyms","myteam","stats","faq","achievements","settings"];
if(!allowed.includes(parent))return;
try{localStorage.setItem(LAST_PAGE_KEY,parent)}catch{}
}
function goPage(n,historyMode="push"){
if(requiresTeamSelection()&&!['home','settings'].includes(n)){
 showTeamRequiredModal();
 n='home';
 historyMode='replace';
}
const wasAlreadyActive=document.getElementById(n+"Page")?.classList.contains("active");
document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
document.getElementById(n+"Page")?.classList.add("active");
document.querySelectorAll(".nav-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.page===n));
document.body.dataset.page=n;
syncTeamPageBackground(n);
if(n!=="detail"){
rememberPage(n);
const allowed=publicMode?["home","dex","stats"]:["home","dex","safari","gyms","myteam","stats","faq","achievements","settings"];
if(allowed.includes(n)&&historyMode!=="none"){
const nextHash=PAGE_HASH_PREFIX+n;
const url=location.pathname+location.search+nextHash;
try{
if(historyMode==="replace")history.replaceState({rfPage:n},"",url);
else if(location.hash!==nextHash)history.pushState({rfPage:n},"",url);
else history.replaceState({rfPage:n},"",url);
}catch{
if(location.hash!==nextHash)location.hash=nextHash;
}
}
}
if(n==="home")renderHome();
if(n==="dex"&&!wasAlreadyActive)renderDex();
if(n==="safari")renderSafari();
if(n==="gyms"){if(gymView==="badges")renderBadgeCase();else renderGyms();}
if(n==="myteam")renderMyTeamPage();
if(n==="stats")renderStats();
if(n==="faq")renderSiteUpdates();
if(n==="achievements")renderAchievementShell();
if(n==="settings")renderFactions();
scrollTo(0,0)
}

function pageFromLocation(){
const h=String(location.hash||"");
if(h.startsWith("#pokemon=")){
try{return {kind:"pokemon",id:decodeURIComponent(h.slice(9))}}catch{return {kind:"pokemon",id:h.slice(9)}}
}
const p=pageFromHash();
return p?{kind:"page",page:p}:{kind:"page",page:savedStartPage(publicMode)};
}
window.addEventListener("popstate",(event)=>{
const allowed=publicMode?["home","dex","stats"]:["home","dex","safari","gyms","myteam","stats","faq","achievements","settings"];
if(event.state?.rfPage==="detail"&&event.state?.pokemonId){
openPokemon(event.state.pokemonId,true);
return;
}
if(event.state?.rfPage&&allowed.includes(event.state.rfPage)){
goPage(event.state.rfPage,"none");
return;
}
const target=pageFromLocation();
if(target.kind==="pokemon"&&target.id){
openPokemon(target.id,true);
return;
}
goPage(allowed.includes(target.page)?target.page:"home","none");
});

try{return localStorage.getItem(RF_SITE_THEME_KEY)==="dark"?"dark":"light"}catch{return document.documentElement.dataset.siteTheme==="dark"?"dark":"light"}
}
function refreshSiteThemeControls(){

document.getElementById("siteThemeDarkBtn")?.classList.toggle("active",mode==="dark");

document.getElementById("siteThemeDarkBtn")?.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(mode==="dark"));
}
function setSiteTheme(mode){
const next=mode==="dark"?"dark":"light";

if(next==="dark")document.documentElement.dataset.siteTheme="dark";else delete document.documentElement.dataset.siteTheme;
refreshSiteThemeControls();
toast(`${next==="dark"?"Dark":"Light"} mode enabled.`);
}
const RF_SETTINGS_STATE_PREFIX="rf_pokemon_settings_state_v1:";
const RF_HUB_MANAGED_SETTINGS_IDS=["adminBuildStatusCard","adminMaintenanceCard","adminTestModeCard"];
function rfSettingsCardKey(card,index){
const heading=card.querySelector(":scope > h3, :scope > .admin-tools-title");
const label=(heading?.textContent||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g," ").toLowerCase();
const stable=(card.id||label||("section-"+index)).replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/g,"-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g,"");
return RF_SETTINGS_STATE_PREFIX+(stable||("section-"+index));
}
function rfIsHubManagedSettingsCard(card){
return !!card?.id&&RF_HUB_MANAGED_SETTINGS_IDS.includes(card.id);
}
function rfSaveSettingsCardState(card,index){
if(!card||rfIsHubManagedSettingsCard(card))return;
try{localStorage.setItem(rfSettingsCardKey(card,index),card.classList.contains("settings-collapsed")?"collapsed":"expanded")}catch{}
}
function rfRestoreSettingsCardState(card,index,heading){
if(card.dataset.rfSettingsStateRestored==="1")return;
card.dataset.rfSettingsStateRestored="1";
let saved=null;
try{saved=localStorage.getItem(rfSettingsCardKey(card,index))}catch{}
if(saved==="collapsed"){
card.classList.add("settings-collapsed");
heading.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
}else if(saved==="expanded"){
card.classList.remove("settings-collapsed");
heading.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true");
}
}
function rfLockHubManagedSettingsCard(card){
if(!card)return;
const heading=card.querySelector(":scope > h3, :scope > .admin-tools-title");
card.classList.add("settings-collapsible","settings-collapsed");
card.dataset.rfHubManagedSettings="1";
if(heading){
heading.classList.add("settings-section-heading");
heading.dataset.collapseReady="1";
heading.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
heading.setAttribute("aria-disabled","true");
heading.removeAttribute("role");
heading.tabIndex=-1;
heading.style.cursor="default";
}
card.querySelectorAll("button,input,select,textarea,a,[role=\"button\"]").forEach(control=>{
try{control.disabled=true}catch{}
control.setAttribute?.("aria-disabled","true");
if(control.tagName==="A"){
control.setAttribute("tabindex","-1");
control.style.pointerEvents="none";
}
});
}
function rfMoveHubManagedSettingsCardsToBottom(){
const root=document.getElementById("settingsPage");
if(!root)return;
RF_HUB_MANAGED_SETTINGS_IDS.forEach(id=>{
const card=document.getElementById(id);
if(card&&card.parentElement===root){
rfLockHubManagedSettingsCard(card);
root.appendChild(card);
}
});
}
function initSettingsSections(){
const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("#settingsPage > .form-card"));
cards.forEach((card,index)=>{
const heading=card.querySelector(":scope > h3, :scope > .admin-tools-title");
if(!heading)return;
if(rfIsHubManagedSettingsCard(card)){
rfLockHubManagedSettingsCard(card);
return;
}
card.classList.add("settings-collapsible");
if(!heading.dataset.collapseReady){
heading.dataset.collapseReady="1";
